part.name: Recoater motor bracket

T1.name: 2.5 in. (63.5 mm) indexable face mill, 4 inserts

T2.name: 3/4 in. (19.05 mm) 3-flute carbide end mill, 66 mm stick-out, ER32 collet chuck

assumptions: Feeds as freecad_cam.py: mm/min = rpm x flutes x chip load x 25.4; plunge at half the horizontal feed.
Face: BoundaryShape Boundbox with ClearEdges (the face's box plus the tool radius), 70 % step-over, zig-zag along x.
Outline: Profile on the top face's outer wire, the tool outside; rough with 0.3 mm left, then finish, each in two 19.5 mm steps (op 1) or one 21.5 mm step (op 2), inside T2's 38.1 mm of flute.

No lead-in or lead-out dressups (the profile plunges at its start point, outside the part, in the 3 mm of stock round it); no chamfers or deburring; the model's screw holes are not drawn, so none are cut.
Times: the G-code recount (feeds as programmed, rapids at 25.4 m/min); tool changes counted, not timed.
